title: The colour rows redraw themselves on every click
goal: Clicking from one shape to another still rebuilds the colour row of every part in the settings panel, even when the colour on screen is exactly the same. It is the biggest thing left of the pause people feel when they click back and forth between two alike shapes: about two milliseconds of a click that now costs about twenty five.
notes:
SUCCESSOR to picking-a-layer-leaves-alone-the-settings-that-d, which did the same thing for the sliders and the picture pickers and took the arrow-to-arrow pick from 33.5 to 25ms. The pattern to copy is Sources/Photonz/PanelReach.swift: a control takes the NAME of what it edits plus the reading it shows, looks the layers up from EditorState when somebody uses it, and is then wrapped in .equatable() so SwiftUI can skip it.

WHY THE COLOUR ROWS ARE HARDER. ColorStyleRow (Sources/Photonz/ColorStylePanel.swift:508) reads editorState.colorStyleSelection(target) and editorState.colorStyleNaming in its OWN body, and so do SelectionColorWell and ColorStyleControl under it. A view that reads the selection itself invalidates on every pick no matter what its parent does, so wrapping it changes nothing: the reading has to be hoisted into PartRowView, which already has row.colors, and handed down.

MEASURED 2026-09-17, probe build, screen locked with PHOTONZ_ALLOW_LOCKED_WALK=1, median of 12 picks, two runs: with PartRowView.colorControl returning nothing the arrow-to-arrow pick is 22.6 and 23.3ms against 24.3 to 25.6 with it. The arrow Caption block is worth about another 1ms (23.2 to 25.2 with ArrowLabelSettings blanked) and could go the same way.

WHAT IS NOT WORTH DOING. Below about 19ms there is nothing in Appearance left to win: blanking PartsInspector entirely reads 16 to 19ms in the same session, and that floor is the canvas, the selection, the layers list and the dock shell. Anyone who wants a pick under 20ms should start there, not here.
acceptance: Picking between two identical arrows costs no more than 23ms of main thread work in its longest single pass, down from 24 to 26 today, measured the way the note in Sources/Photonz/InspectorPanel.swift says: build the probe once, then take every reading with Scripts/playtest/perf/pick-cost-walk.json --no-build

A colour row the click left alone still paints the layer that is NOW picked: straight after clicking from one arrow to another, dropping a colour on the Line row paints the arrow clicked last and nothing happens to the other one
Nothing shows a stale colour: after picking a red arrow and then a blue one, the Line row shows blue
Scripts/playtest/pick-leaves-settings-alone-walk.json, arrow-parts-walk, shape-parts-walk and one-color-picker-walk all pass, run before and after
